papers_used.title: A Comprehensive Measurement of the Local Value of the Hubble Constant with 1 km s-1 Mpc-1 Uncertainty from the Hubble Space Telescope and the SH0ES Team
papers_used.relevance: Provides the modern SH0ES Cepheid+SN Ia baseline around H0 ~ 73 km s^-1 Mpc^-1 and anchor logic.

papers_used.title: Small Magellanic Cloud Cepheids Observed with the Hubble Space Telescope Provide a New Anchor for the SH0ES Distance Ladder
papers_used.relevance: Confirms the role of multiple geometric anchors and the target H0 scale near 73 km s^-1 Mpc^-1.

papers_used.title: Coordinated JWST Imaging of Three Distance Indicators in a SN Host Galaxy and an Estimate of the TRGB Color Dependence
papers_used.relevance: Confirms that TRGB/JAGB/Cepheid cross-calibration and geometric-anchor transfer are central to current distance-ladder work.

papers_used.title: The Pantheon+ Analysis: The Full Dataset and Light-Curve Release
papers_used.relevance: Provides context for modern SN Ia Hubble-flow data products used by local-ladder analyses.

contract_updates: The full literature target is a multi-anchor, multi-indicator ladder with H0 near 73 km s^-1 Mpc^-1 rather than ~110 km s^-1 Mpc^-1.
The workspace minimal dataset is a reduced pedagogical subset, so exact reproduction of the full-paper precision and full indicator set is not possible from workspace data alone.
The final report should explicitly separate direct workspace reconstruction from literature context and should not claim full-paper reproduction.
